		change_relative_party_popularity = yes

		set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = 0.02 }
		set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = 0.02 }
		change_relative_party_popularity = yes
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
}

		name = COLDWAR_AFG.705.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_AFG.705.a executed"
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_revolt_change = -8 }
		COLDWAR_AFG_change_revolt = yes
		add_stability = -0.02
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
}

# SOV scope: one withdrawal step every 90 days
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_AFG.707
	title = COLDWAR_AFG.707.t
	desc = COLDWAR_AFG.707.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal

	is_triggered_only = yes
	hidden = yes
	trigger = { original_tag = SOV }

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_AFG.707"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_AFG.707.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_AFG.707.a executed"
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level = 1 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level min = 0 max = 3 }
		COLDWAR_AFG_update_syndrome = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_level > 0 } }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_AFG.707 days = 90 }
		}
		else = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_withdrawing
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_offer_limited_contingent_consent } COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_end = yes }
		}
	}
}

# supporter scope: support ends when the Geneva Accords take effect
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_AFG.708
	title = COLDWAR_AFG.708.t
	desc = COLDWAR_AFG.708.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal

	is_triggered_only = yes
	hidden = yes
	trigger = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_supporter }

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_AFG.708"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_AFG.708.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_AFG.708.a executed"
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_cyclone } COLDWAR_AFG_end_support_cyclone = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_isi } COLDWAR_AFG_end_support_isi = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_tehran } COLDWAR_AFG_end_support_tehran = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_saudi } COLDWAR_AFG_end_support_saudi = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_china } COLDWAR_AFG_end_support_china = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_sup_mi6 } COLDWAR_AFG_end_support_mi6 = yes }
	}
}

# SOV scope: the Geneva Accords start the withdrawal
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_AFG.709
	title = COLDWAR_AFG.709.t
	desc = COLDWAR_AFG.709.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal

	is_triggered_only = yes
	hidden = yes
	trigger = { original_tag = SOV }

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_AFG.709"
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_AFG.709.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [This.GetName]: COLDWAR_AFG.709.a executed"
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AFG_contingent_withdrawing } } COLDWAR_AFG_begin_withdrawal = yes }
	}
}
